create_load_credential_pool: load a credential pool for a provider, seeding from singletons, env vars, and config
create_add_credential_entry: add a credential entry to a provider pool with priority ordering and persistence
build_select_credential: select the next available credential from a pool using fill_first, round_robin, random, or least_used strategy
test_mark_exhausted_rotate: mark a credential exhausted on failure and rotate to the next available credential in the pool
refactor_refresh_credential: refresh an OAuth credential entry and sync updated tokens back to the auth store and credentials file
